metadata.dcterms:title: DIAGRAM CATEGORIES FOR Uq-TILTING MODULES
metadata.dcterms:creator: ANDERSEN, HENNING HAAHR
TUBBENHAUER, DANIEL
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We give a diagrammatic presentation of the category of Uq(sl2)-tilting modules T for q being a root of unity and introduce a grading on T. This grading is a “root of unity phenomenon” and might lead to new insights about link and 3-manifold invariants deduced from T. We also give a diagrammatic category for the (graded) projective endofunctors on T, indicate how our results could generalize and collect some “well-known” facts to give a reasonably self-contained exposition.
